title: Ringed subspace with the inverse-image structure sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a locally ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and $S\subseteq |X|$ any subset. Give $S$ the subspace topology and let $i:S\hookrightarrow |X|$ be inclusion. The ringed subspace $X|_S$ is $(S,i^{-1}\mathcal O_X)$, using the inverse-image sheaf of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Its canonical ringed-space morphism to $X$ has base $i$ and sheaf map the unit $\mathcal O_X\to i_*i^{-1}\mathcal O_X$. When supplied with a proof that its stalks are local rings, bundle this same ringed space as a locally ringed space; only proof data are supplied, and its topology and sheaf remain the specified ones.
